name: nexus
description: A production-grade terminal Coding Agent. Context is king, tools first, human in the loop.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external react-devtools-core
scripts.test:coverage: bun test tests/unit/ tests/integration/ --coverage --test-name-pattern '^(?:(?!(Tree-sitter|SkillPlugin)).)*$' && bun test tests/unit/treesitter.test.ts && bun test tests/unit/pluginLoader.test.ts tests/unit/skillLibrary.test.ts
scripts.test:isolated: bun run scripts/run-tests-isolated.ts && bun test tests/unit/treesitter.test.ts && bun test tests/unit/pluginLoader.test.ts tests/unit/skillLibrary.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage:ci: bun test tests/unit/ tests/integration/ --coverage --test-name-pattern '^(?:(?!(Tree-sitter|SkillPlugin)).)*$' --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-reporter=text-summary && bun test tests/unit/treesitter.test.ts && bun test tests/unit/pluginLoader.test.ts tests/unit/skillLibrary.test.ts
scripts.lint: bunx biome check src/ packages/ && bunx tsc --noEmit
